soldOutNow: Sorry, this item is no longer available.
cartExpired: Your cart expired and the items were released.
errName: Write your name, for example Camille.
errEmail: Write a full address, for example camille@example.org.
errAddress: Write the full address with street, number, town and country.
errRate: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
errGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
qtyLimit: You cannot add more of this item.
awaitingHelp: Your items are held for you until the payment is received.
ordersEmpty: No order yet. Add a product to start selling.
productsEmpty: No product yet. Add your first product.
readOnly: You can look but not change.
noRight: You are not allowed to do this.
saveFailed: The change could not be saved.
fTaxRate: Tax rate included in the price
err_title: Write a name, for example Plush fox.
err_price: Write a price above zero, for example 12.50.
err_stock: Write a whole number, for example 3.
err_tax: Write a rate between 0 and 100, for example 21.
err_variants: Check the options: one per line, like Large | 24.00 | 3.
resolveHelp: This order was paid after the pieces were released and they are gone. Decide on a refund or a restock.
paidToResolve: Payment recorded, but the pieces are no longer available.
errTransition: This move is not possible from the current state.
payPending: Your payment is being confirmed. This page updates itself.
payFailed: The payment was not completed. You can try again.
payStartFailed: The payment page could not be opened. Try again, or contact the shop.
testModeBanner: Test mode: payments made now use no real money.
flag_paid_after_cancel: A payment arrived for a cancelled order. Refund it at your provider.
flag_payment_mismatch: The amount paid is not the amount of the order. Check it at your provider.
onlineHoldSetting: Items held during an online payment (minutes)
closedForMail: The shop is closed for now. Please come back later.
needMailBanner: The shop is closed: the site cannot send e-mail yet. It opens by itself once e-mail is set up.
providerNotReady: A payment extension is installed but not ready. Open it to finish.
mailPlacedOnline: Pay securely online from that page. Your items are held for a short time.
mailPlacedNoHow: We will tell you how to pay. Your items are held for you meanwhile.
mail_paid_body:
Hello {name},

We received your payment for order {number} at {site}. We are preparing it.

You can follow it with the link in our first message.
mail_shipped_subject: Your order {number} is on its way
mail_shipped_body:
Hello {name},

Your order {number} at {site} has been sent.
{extra}

You can follow it with the link in our first message.
mail_cancelled_body:
Hello {name},

Your order {number} at {site} was cancelled.
If you already paid, the shop will contact you about it.
digestFailed: {n} e-mail(s) could not be sent to customers.
mailFailedBanner: {n} e-mail(s) could not be sent in the last days. Check your e-mail settings.
mailWaitingBanner: {n} e-mail(s) are waiting. They go out as soon as the hourly limit allows.
mail_link_body:
Hello {name},

Here is a new link to follow your order {number} at {site}: {url}
The previous link no longer works. Keep this one.

If you did not expect this message, you can ignore it.
linkSent: A new link has been sent. The previous one no longer works.
linkNotSent: The e-mail could not be written. The previous link still works.
linkLimit: Too many new links today for this order. Try again tomorrow.
